title: sophora unifoliata
intro: Sophora unifoliata, commonly known as the one-leaf Sophora or Keishi-buki, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that help to promote wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Sophora unifoliata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential interactions of Sophora unifoliata, and it should only be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
